description: This Java interface defines a repository for LoanBuyDownFeeBalance entities, including custom query methods for retrieving fee balance data related to loans, used within the Fineract microfinance platform.

classes.name: LoanBuyDownFeeBalanceRepository
classes.description: Repository interface for LoanBuyDownFeeBalance with custom query methods for loan fee balance operations.

methods.name: findAllByLoanIdAndClosedFalse
methods.description: Retrieves all non-closed fee balances for a specific loan ID.

methods.name: findAllByLoanIdAndDeletedFalseAndClosedFalse
methods.description: Retrieves all non-closed, non-deleted fee balances for a specific loan ID.

methods.name: findByLoanIdAndLoanTransactionIdAndDeletedFalseAndClosedFalse
methods.description: Finds a specific fee balance by loan ID and transaction ID, ensuring it is not deleted or closed.

methods.name: findBalanceForAdjustment
methods.description: Finds the fee balance associated with a specific transaction for adjustment purposes.

methods.name: findBaseTransactionInfo
methods.description: Retrieves detailed DTO info about a base transaction for a given loan transaction and loan ID.
